metadata.author: SHR Drums contributors
metadata.source: Deterministic SHR Drums modeled synthesis; no samples, recordings, downloads, or generated audio assets
metadata.attribution: No attribution required; every voice is synthesized in real time
metadata.modification_notes: Authored as 27 distinct acid-house and acid-techno drum-machine voices. Deliberate body/layer/master clipping, saturation, feedback, FM, ring modulation, wavefolding, parallel compression, and flat-topped transients precede an independent protected kit ceiling.
